evidence.claim: The federal government issued a mandatory Program Estratégico de Salud para el Bienestar that aims to guarantee progressive, free, integral health services for people without social security and to strengthen federalization of health services.
evidence.title: ACUERDO por el que se emite el Programa Estratégico de Salud para el Bienestar
evidence.publisher: Diario Oficial de la Federación / Secretaría de Salud
evidence.excerpt: The federal government issued a mandatory Program Estratégico de Salud para el Bienestar that aims to guarantee progressive, free, integral health services for people without social security and to strengthen federalization of health services.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official legal instrument with explicit obligations, coverage aims, and federalization language.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 policy design and implementation framework.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's government through the federal health secretariat and the national plan it cites.
contrary_evidence: This is a program order, not proof of achieved outcomes.
It does not by itself show service quality or equal access across regions.

evidence.claim: AMLO said 25 million families would receive direct benefits in 2022, equal to about 70 percent of Mexican families, and that the poorest states were already being covered at 100 percent of households.
evidence.title: El 70% de las familias son beneficiarias de al menos uno de los Programas para el Bienestar
evidence.publisher: Programas para el Bienestar / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: AMLO said 25 million families would receive direct benefits in 2022, equal to about 70 percent of Mexican families, and that the poorest states were already being covered at 100 percent of households.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct presidential remarks published on the government welfare portal with specific coverage claims.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO, who publicly presented the distribution and coverage claims.
contrary_evidence: The claims are self-reported and do not prove outcomes or absence of exclusion.
Universal coverage in poor states is not the same as equal quality or adequacy of support.

evidence.claim: Mexico launched Bienpesca 2022 with more than 1,360 million pesos to benefit 189,000 fishers and aquaculture workers, paying each beneficiary 7,200 pesos directly and without intermediaries.
evidence.title: Gobierno de México inicia la entrega de apoyos Bienpesca 2022
evidence.publisher: Programas para el Bienestar / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: Mexico launched Bienpesca 2022 with more than 1,360 million pesos to benefit 189,000 fishers and aquaculture workers, paying each beneficiary 7,200 pesos directly and without intermediaries.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Government welfare portal with explicit budget, beneficiary, and anti-intermediary language.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to AMLO's government because the program is presented as a federal welfare policy under his administration.
contrary_evidence: This is a sector-specific transfer program, not a broad social-service overhaul.
The source is self-reported and does not test impacts on living standards.

evidence.claim: AMLO framed the 4T as a government focused on welfare for the whole population, especially the neediest, and said governability and peace remained priorities.
evidence.title: Gobierno de México garantiza bienestar y gobernabilidad, afirma presidente en 4° aniversario del triunfo de la 4T en elecciones
evidence.excerpt: AMLO framed the 4T as a government focused on welfare for the whole population, especially the neediest, and said governability and peace remained priorities.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential transcript; strong for stated program and revealed priorities, though self-presenting.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's own articulated program.
contrary_evidence: It states intent and self-description, not verified implementation or impact.

evidence.claim: The 2022 budget package was designed around social welfare, regional projects, and fiscal stability, with higher programmed spending for social protection, investment, health, education, and more stable debt.
evidence.title: Comunicado No. 052 Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público entrega Paquete Económico 2022 al Congreso
evidence.publisher: Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público
evidence.excerpt: The 2022 budget package was designed around social welfare, regional projects, and fiscal stability, with higher programmed spending for social protection, investment, health, education, and more stable debt.
evidence.source_locator: bullet list under 'tres pilares' and spending paragraphs
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary budget document from the finance ministry; strong for declared priorities and resource allocation.
evidence.period_fit: It sets the 2022 policy framework and funding priorities used during the target year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's administration through the federal budget process.
contrary_evidence: It is a plan and allocation statement, not proof that all spending translated into effective delivery.

evidence.claim: The PACIC was launched to stabilize prices for 24 basic food items and raise domestic food production instead of using a formal price-control regime.
evidence.title: Comunicado No. 37 Presenta el secretario de Hacienda el Paquete Contra la Inflación y la Carestía
evidence.publisher: Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público
evidence.excerpt: The PACIC was launched to stabilize prices for 24 basic food items and raise domestic food production instead of using a formal price-control regime.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary government record of the anti-inflation package and its stated mechanism.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's administration and its inflation-response strategy.
contrary_evidence: The effectiveness of the package had to be judged against later inflation outcomes and fiscal cost.

evidence.claim: The health ministry said 15 states had completed the federalization data-gathering process for IMSS-Bienestar and that 10,920 doctors had been recruited to support free care, equipment, and medicines.
evidence.title: Acceso a la atención médica gratuita, prioridad del modelo de salud IMSS-Bienestar: Alcocer
evidence.excerpt: The health ministry said 15 states had completed the federalization data-gathering process for IMSS-Bienestar and that 10,920 doctors had been recruited to support free care, equipment, and medicines.
evidence.source_locator: mid-article paragraphs on state participation and staffing
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary ministry announcement with concrete operational metrics and rollout detail.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's health-system rollout and federalization agenda.
contrary_evidence: It is a rollout statement; it does not alone prove system-wide quality or equal coverage.

evidence.claim: The SEP said 2022 education programs received higher budgets, including a 13.7% increase for La Escuela es Nuestra, a 4% increase for Benito Juárez scholarships, and more funding for special education.
evidence.title: Boletín SEP no. 24 Reciben programas educativos incremento presupuestal para 2022: Delfina Gómez Álvarez
evidence.excerpt: The SEP said 2022 education programs received higher budgets, including a 13.7% increase for La Escuela es Nuestra, a 4% increase for Benito Juárez scholarships, and more funding for special education.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary education-ministry budget announcement with concrete program-level funding changes.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's budgetary priorities and education implementation.
contrary_evidence: Budget increases do not by themselves prove learning or equity gains.

evidence.claim: La Escuela es Nuestra delivered funds directly to school parent committees, which decide use for construction, maintenance, equipment, longer hours, or student feeding.
evidence.title: Comunicado de prensa 003/2022 Madres y padres de familia son quienes deciden el uso de los recursos de La Escuela es Nuestra
evidence.excerpt: La Escuela es Nuestra delivered funds directly to school parent committees, which decide use for construction, maintenance, equipment, longer hours, or student feeding.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary program rule announcement with clear delivery mechanism and local implementation design.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's delivery model for education spending.
contrary_evidence: Direct community control can improve reach, but the source itself does not measure outcomes.

evidence.claim: AMLO said the AIFA opened on time and within the original budget, presenting it as a major infrastructure delivery achieved despite legal, technical, pandemic, and supply-chain constraints.
evidence.title: 21.03.22 Versión estenográfica. Recepción e inicio de operaciones del Aeropuerto Internacional Felipe Ángeles
evidence.excerpt: AMLO said the AIFA opened on time and within the original budget, presenting it as a major infrastructure delivery achieved despite legal, technical, pandemic, and supply-chain constraints.
evidence.source_locator: central opening paragraphs on budget, timing, and construction progress
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential transcript documenting the launch and the administration's own delivery claim.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's own infrastructure program and the government's execution claim.
contrary_evidence: The source is self-reporting and does not by itself establish demand or operational success after opening.

evidence.claim: AMLO's plan to increase state control of power generation was defeated in parliament after opposition parties argued it would hurt investment and breach international obligations.
evidence.title: Mexican president's contentious electricity overhaul defeated in Congress
evidence.excerpt: AMLO's plan to increase state control of power generation was defeated in parliament after opposition parties argued it would hurt investment and breach international obligations.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting on a concrete legislative defeat and the stated investor concerns.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's policy push, though legislative defeat also reflects opposition strength and coalition limits.
contrary_evidence: Defeat in Congress is not the same as administrative incompetence, but it does show failure to convert the proposal into law.

evidence.claim: The OECD said uncertainty rose after electricity-market reform proposals, investment had been weak since 2015, and investors needed certainty about contracts and regulatory stability to restart growth.
evidence.title: OECD Economic Surveys: Mexico 2022
evidence.excerpt: The OECD said uncertainty rose after electricity-market reform proposals, investment had been weak since 2015, and investors needed certainty about contracts and regulatory stability to restart growth.
evidence.source_locator: summary text near the discussion of investment and electricity reform
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent economic survey with direct policy diagnosis and investment assessment.
evidence.period_fit: Directly relevant to the 2022 policy environment.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to AMLO's policy program and the uncertainty it created, though some investment weakness predates his term.
contrary_evidence: The OECD also acknowledged Mexico's solid macro framework, so the picture is mixed rather than uniformly negative.

evidence.claim: The World Bank approved a US$700 million operation tied to policies that simplify the business environment, promote financial inclusion, strengthen sustainable economic management, and help vulnerable groups benefit from growth.
evidence.title: Banco Mundial y México colaboran para impulsar el crecimiento económico inclusivo y sostenible
evidence.excerpt: The World Bank approved a US$700 million operation tied to policies that simplify the business environment, promote financial inclusion, strengthen sustainable economic management, and help vulnerable groups benefit from growth.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs and quoted remarks from the World Bank director
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent development-finance approval with explicit policy linkages and targeted objectives.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to AMLO's policy agenda as adopted by the government, though the operation is a partnership and not a ruler-only achievement.
contrary_evidence: The approval confirms a policy framework, not final results.

evidence.claim: Reuters reported that Mexico's anti-inflation subsidies cost about 575 billion pesos in 2022, mostly through gasoline support, and officials said inflation would have been 2.6 percentage points higher without them.
evidence.title: Mexico anti-inflation subsidies come with $28 billion price tag
evidence.excerpt: Reuters reported that Mexico's anti-inflation subsidies cost about 575 billion pesos in 2022, mostly through gasoline support, and officials said inflation would have been 2.6 percentage points higher without them.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting with concrete fiscal and inflation claims; the exact counterfactual estimate is official and should be treated cautiously.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to AMLO's crisis-management strategy, though the inflation environment was also driven by global shocks.
contrary_evidence: Heavy subsidies have fiscal costs and do not demonstrate durable price control by themselves.

evidence.claim: ASF reported nine irregularities in the AIFA construction audits, including payments without documentation, uncredited materials, missing project and budget documentation, and other execution gaps across a 17,006 million peso sample.
evidence.title: Conoce las observaciones que la ASF hizo al AIFA
evidence.excerpt: ASF reported nine irregularities in the AIFA construction audits, including payments without documentation, uncredited materials, missing project and budget documentation, and other execution gaps across a 17,006 million peso sample.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Secondary reporting that directly quotes and summarizes the ASF's audit findings with concrete numeric detail.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within 2022 and tied to construction executed under AMLO's program.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's flagship project implementation through the federal security/transport apparatus, though the audit concerns construction management rather than personal conduct.
contrary_evidence: Audit observations are not final judicial findings and may be partially clarified later.

evidence.claim: AIFA carried 13,716 passengers in March 2022, with 67 departures and 66 arrivals, indicating very low early utilization after opening.
evidence.title: AIFA transportó a 13 mil 716 pasajeros en marzo; Cancún la ruta más solicitada
evidence.excerpt: AIFA carried 13,716 passengers in March 2022, with 67 departures and 66 arrivals, indicating very low early utilization after opening.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs on passenger totals and flights
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reporting cites AFAC traffic figures and gives a concrete early utilization snapshot.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within the target year, immediately after the March 21 opening.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to AMLO's flagship airport project and its early operational uptake; low traffic reflects demand and airline relocation constraints as well as design choices.
contrary_evidence: A new airport's first month is a ramp-up period, so this is an early implementation outcome rather than final performance.

evidence.claim: Pemex requested almost $6.5 billion more for Dos Bocas, pushing the refinery's projected cost to $14.6 billion, far above the original $8.9 billion budget, because of works not initially included and higher construction/startup costs.
evidence.title: Mexico's Pemex requests $6.5 billion more funding for 'Dos Bocas' refinery -documents, source
evidence.excerpt: Pemex requested almost $6.5 billion more for Dos Bocas, pushing the refinery's projected cost to $14.6 billion, far above the original $8.9 billion budget, because of works not initially included and higher construction/startup costs.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting based on a document and multiple sources, with specific figures and budget comparisons.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's signature energy project and the administration's execution choices, though higher costs also reflect project complexity and inflation.
contrary_evidence: Cost escalation does not prove failure on its own; it does show serious budget pressure and incomplete initial planning.

evidence.claim: The ASF reported more than 573 million pesos in unresolved observations for La Escuela es Nuestra, including missing documentation, lack of proof of use of support funds, and the absence of periodic monitoring, supervision, and evaluation mechanisms.
evidence.title: La ASF detecta 573 mdp 'perdidos' en el programa La Escuela es Nuestra
evidence.excerpt: The ASF reported more than 573 million pesos in unresolved observations for La Escuela es Nuestra, including missing documentation, lack of proof of use of support funds, and the absence of periodic monitoring, supervision, and evaluation mechanisms.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Secondary reporting that quotes and summarizes the ASF audit findings in detail, with specific amounts and mechanism failures.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within 2022, reviewing the program's 2020 operation and 2022 continuation.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's education policy design and rollout through SEP, though the audit concerns program controls rather than intent.
contrary_evidence: The article also notes that the predecessor schools-of-full-day model had positive learning findings, so the policy choice was a tradeoff rather than a blank failure.

evidence.claim: Mexico's Ministry of Education, with UNICEF and partners, used government-led Learning Camps to close foundational learning gaps, reaching thousands of children with targeted literacy and numeracy instruction and showing measurable gains in weeks.
evidence.title: Teaching at the Right Level supports learning recovery in Mexico
evidence.excerpt: Mexico's Ministry of Education, with UNICEF and partners, used government-led Learning Camps to close foundational learning gaps, reaching thousands of children with targeted literacy and numeracy instruction and showing measurable gains in weeks.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: UNICEF case study with concrete implementation and outcome language, albeit focused on a targeted intervention rather than the entire system.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Partly attributable to AMLO's education ministry and its recovery strategy, though UNICEF and partners share implementation and the case study is not a national average.
contrary_evidence: This is a case study of a targeted intervention, not a full audit of national learning outcomes.

evidence.claim: The IMF said Mexico's recovery accelerated in the first half of 2022 due to catch-up momentum, improving labor markets, and fiscal policy support, while weaker U.S. and global growth and tighter financial conditions were key drag factors; it also noted broadly neutral fiscal policy and untargeted subsidies to offset cost-of-living pressures.
evidence.title: IMF Executive Board Concludes 2022 Article IV Consultation with Mexico
evidence.excerpt: The IMF said Mexico's recovery accelerated in the first half of 2022 due to catch-up momentum, improving labor markets, and fiscal policy support, while weaker U.S. and global growth and tighter financial conditions were key drag factors; it also noted broadly neutral fiscal policy and untargeted subsidies to offset cost-of-living pressures.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent Article IV surveillance with explicit macro attribution, policy description, and contemporaneous assessment.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Mostly attributable to AMLO's administration in combination with external shocks and inherited macro frameworks; the IMF explicitly separates policy support from external drag.
contrary_evidence: The IMF does not isolate AMLO-only causal shares, and some recovery drivers were inherited or external.

evidence.claim: The IMF said Mexico qualified for the Flexible Credit Line because of very strong macroeconomic policies and institutional policy frameworks, while also warning that a more turbulent external environment and rising external risks were complicating the recovery.
evidence.title: Mexico: Review Under the Flexible Credit Line Arrangement-Press Release; and Staff Report
evidence.excerpt: The IMF said Mexico qualified for the Flexible Credit Line because of very strong macroeconomic policies and institutional policy frameworks, while also warning that a more turbulent external environment and rising external risks were complicating the recovery.
evidence.source_locator: summary/abstract and opening context in the IMF review
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent IMF review that explicitly links resilience to policy frameworks and notes external-risk pressure.
evidence.ruler_attribution: This mostly reflects Mexico's institutional macro framework, some of which predated AMLO; the review is useful mainly for separating inherited resilience from AMLO-era policy choices.
contrary_evidence: Because the framework predates AMLO in part, this source limits how much credit can be assigned to 2022 ruler choices alone.

unresolved_gaps: Direct 2022 evidence on AMLO's personal control over civilian-nuclear safety appointments, regulatory discipline, or command-side decisions is thin.
There is no Mexico-originating war, proxy conflict, or coercive peace leverage in 2022, so the dossier is mostly diplomatic posture rather than operational conflict conduct.
Specific chain-of-command evidence for some police, military, and intelligence abuses remains incomplete, especially for local versus federal responsibility.
Some of the evidence about electoral reform and media pressure is rhetorical or journalistic rather than a direct legal finding of intent to entrench power.
The causal split between AMLO policy, inherited weakness, and global shocks is still only partially recoverable for 2022 poverty, inflation, and investment outcomes.
Independent post-launch quality and outcome audits for IMSS-Bienestar, education recovery, and related welfare programs are thinner than the rollout record.
Direct documentary evidence of personal enrichment, hidden financial benefit, or knowing approval of surveillance remains limited.
Durability and post-launch independent audits for AIFA, Dos Bocas, IMSS-Bienestar, and the education programs are thinner than the implementation record.

run_provenance.source_mix_note: Rich source metadata and chapter-specific reviewer exclusions were preserved during deterministic conversion.
